broken.label: Funnel handoff: qualified → booked is 26 → 0

broken.label: Engaged % equals Qualified %
broken.root_cause: Both metrics compute from the same set of outcome_tag values (hot+warm). No separate qualification threshold defined.

broken.label: Spam-number / VOIP detection
broken.root_cause: Does not exist. Blake calls every contact GHL hands him, including obvious VOIP and toll-free ranges. Estimated dial waste unknown until Audit 1.4.
